en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course is focused on developing of oral and written communication skills, both heard and written text comprehension, fixation of grammar knowledge and extension of horticulture vocabulary, analysing athentic texts and learning and using professional collocation, e.g. hollow stalk, taproot, budding, grafting, hydrophonics, indicator of the state of the environment etc.
